name: Makeup Star
desc:
💄 Makeup Star, the makeup & beauty game where you paint real looks BY HAND!

✨ Sit at your own vanity and do a full glow up yourself: skin prep, blush, lipstick, eyeshadow, eyeliner, lashes, glitter and gems.
🔒 Your makeup is private: only you see your looks.
🎨 No timer, no limits: paint as much as you like, layer after layer.
📖 Save your favourite looks in your Look Diary and wear them again any time.
💾 Leave any time: your look waits on your vanity exactly as you left it.
🖼️ Full View hides everything but your model, so you can admire every detail.
📸 Snap a photo of your look and save or share it.
💇 Style your model with cute hairstyles, lashes and jewelry.
💅 Give makeovers to sweet Salon customers and make their beauty wishes come true.
🛍️ Earn Pearls for every finished look and spend them on new shades, finishes and treats in the Beauty Bar.

🎁 Code: GLAMSTAR for 500 Pearls!
💕 Join the group for updates and a free reward!
👍 Having fun? Leave a thumbs up!
